name: Dysostosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Dysostosis

criteria.description: Presence of congenital malformations of bones detected clinically or radiologically
Characteristic radiographic abnormalities including abnormal bone shape, size, or number
Exclusion of other skeletal dysplasias and syndromes by clinical and genetic evaluation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital bone malformations with characteristic radiographic abnormalities and exclusion of other skeletal dysplasias
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may assist in diagnosis but is not always definitive due to heterogeneity

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital aplasia or hypoplasia of specific bones
searchTerms: missing or underdeveloped bones at birth
absent or small bones present from birth
abnormally small arm or leg bones

common.symptomName: Limited joint mobility due to bone malformations
searchTerms: limited joint movement due to bone shape

occasional.symptomName: Hearing impairment due to ossicular malformations
searchTerms: hearing loss from middle ear bone problems
impaired hearing due to ear bone malformations

occasional.symptomName: Dental anomalies including hypodontia or malformed teeth
Respiratory complications secondary to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: breathing issues due to chest wall deformities
respiratory problems from rib cage abnormalities

occasional.symptomName: Mild developmental delay in some cases
searchTerms: mild delay in learning or development

rare.symptomName: Cardiovascular malformations associated with skeletal anomalies
Renal anomalies associated with skeletal dysplasia
searchTerms: kidney defects associated with bone problems

rare.symptomName: Cutaneous abnormalities such as skin hypoplasia

laboratory: Normal routine laboratory tests; no specific biochemical markers
imaging: X-ray showing aplasia, hypoplasia, or abnormal segmentation of bones
CT or MRI for detailed bone structure evaluation
genetic: Mutations in genes related to bone development (varies by subtype)
Genetic heterogeneity with multiple implicated loci
other: Clinical examination revealing characteristic bone malformations

redFlags: Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformities
Rapidly worsening skeletal deformities causing functional impairment
references: UpToDate: Overview of congenital bone malformations
